decision: Two original exports and the preceding v0.21 game adapter agree byte for byte. Pre-acceptance corrections fixed an invalid test cast mode and incorrectly nested reload options; explicit refusal, scoped refill and fractional-bank assertions now guard those setups. Original data and code were never changed. Added native shotgun/arquebus reloads, optional-fuel affordability refusals and fractional movement bleed before accepting this fixture.
observations: Each update grants at most one passive round and carries remaining time.
A real press resets the rest timer after empty-magazine cooldown stamping.
Optional-fuel affordability refusal does not create a lazy bank.
Active restoration clears the reload flag only when it adds rounds; it retains partial rest time.
Movement bleed can make a fractional bank slightly negative, retained by the original implementation.
Reload target selection, host cooldown/cue completion, channel release and shared admission remain host responsibilities.
